# Duck Donald Trump

> Political humor merch. Two T-shirts on the Comfort Colors 1717, a hoodie, and a trucker hat,: a cartoon rubber duck with an orange combover and a stencil "*uck Donald Trump." Sold in Terracotta, Butter, and White, printed and shipped on demand by Printful. $5 from every item goes to Democracy Forward Foundation, a 501(c)(3) legal nonprofit.
